notes.title: New game mode is available in a major update!
notes.notes:
A large update for the game is now released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261224/d3f2345d2e197a1444c23ead65df04263cd6cae0.jpg[/img]

I'm sorry this new level looks a little too empty because I set the scope too large to finish (unfortunately just like when this first game was released ). However, the game mechanic should be enough to convey the game idea I want to share.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261224/f827bd0afd2d6d1755005dafdf2bd8b225167e97.jpg[/img]

I hope to spend more time on updating this game if it gets more popular. Meanwhile, I will move on to another project.

Please feel free to leave constructive feedback on my game and I will update it if there are any major issues.

[hr][/hr]
The new game mode introduces two new factions. The Shoplifters and the Mall Security.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261224/e3bde7306daac80c0901a194fd548242f98bb48c.jpg[/img]

As shoplifters, your objective is to steal as much valuable items as possible from the mall without alerting the mall security. You can't carry too much from being overweight yourself, so make sure to plan well what goods to pick. Once you are satisfied with your loot, get to your getaway car to accomplish your objective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261224/174c5d8c89dc8afb520ccc9b1da2814100e56a86.jpg[/img]

Vice versa, as mall security, your mission is to keep the mall safe from shoplifters by taking advantage of all the monitor systems such as surveillance cameras, bulletin, and patrol.

You can even request a bag check on the customers but be careful not to abuse it because you will lose the security reputation from guest complaints.
